task.title: Determining if the period of incapacity has changed

step.cmd: Determine if the new recovery week is after the recovery week in FTS:

ul.li: If the new recovery week is the same as the recovery week in FTS, go to No change to the period of incapacity . No change to the period of incapacity
If the new recovery week is before the recovery week in FTS, go to step 3.
If the new recovery week is after the recovery week in FTS, go to Recovery is after the recovery week in FTS . Recovery is after the recovery week in FTS

step.cmd: Determine if the client has been paid sickness benefits after the new recovery week:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 4.
If no, go to Early recovery . Early recovery

step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to determine if the client has recovered:

ul.li: If yes, explain to the client that an overpayment (OP) will result and go to step 5.
If no, ask the client to obtain a medical certificate for the period of sickness benefits paid after the new recovery week.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 6.
If no , or if the client did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Period of incapacity not supported by a medical certificate . Period of incapacity not supported by a medical certificate

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Medical Proof .

Comments: Select the appropriate option:
If the client has not recovered, type “Medical certificate needed.”
If the client recovered early, type “Early recovery.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Select Save .
If the client indicated a medical certificate will be submitted, go to step 8.
If the client recovered early, go to step 10.
If the client indicated a medical certificate will not be submitted, go to Period of incapacity not supported by a medical certificate . Period of incapacity not supported by a medical certificate

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Medical certificate .
Comments: Type “Verify client submitted an acceptable medical certificate for benefits paid after recovery.”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.
Select Save .

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, determine if a medical certificate for the payment of sickness benefits after the recovery week has been submitted:

ul.li: If yes, return to the beginning of this task.
If no, go to Period of incapacity not supported by a medical certificate . Period of incapacity not supported by a medical certificate

step.cmd: If the client is correcting previously provided information or providing previously omitted information, determine if the information may impact the client’s entitlement to benefits previously paid:

ul.li: If no, go to Period of incapacity not supported by a medical certificate . Period of incapacity not supported by a medical certificate
If yes, determine if the issue should be referred to Integrity by consulting Determining if an issue must be referred to Integrity . Determining if an issue must be referred to Integrity
